title: Honored to welcome our special guest for World Cleanup Day 2026 in Hanoi
summary: We are extremely honored to announce that Ms. Siisi Saetalu, Chargé d’Affaires ad interim of Estonia to the Socialist Republic of Vietnam, will be joining us as our Special Guest at World Cleanup Day 2026 in Hanoi!

contentBlocks.value: We are extremely honored to announce that Ms. Siisi Saetalu, Chargé d’Affaires ad interim of Estonia to the Socialist Republic of Vietnam, will be joining us as our Special Guest at World Cleanup Day 2026 in Hanoi!

Estonia is the birthplace of the global Let’s Do It! movement, which started in 2008 and has since inspired millions of volunteers across 190+ countries to stand up for a cleaner planet. Having Ms. Siisi Saetalu delivering the opening remarks brings immense diplomatic inspiration and reinforces the strong international collaboration behind this green mission.
We look forward to hearing her inspiring message as we join hands with volunteers, partners, and communities nationwide to build a waste-free future.

• Date & Time: Saturday, September 19, 2026 | 07:30 AM – 11:30 AM
• Location: Pham Hung Street, Nam Tu Liem, Hanoi
Join us in welcoming Ms. Siisi Saetalu and register to be part of the movement.
